messages:
Owen: hey folks, owen here (first week). my PR pipeline keeps failing on the `publish-image` step with a 403/denied from GHCR. I thought the GITHUB_TOKEN used by our GH Actions had permissions, but this is Buildkite. who owns the creds we should be using?

InfraBot: Buildkite: build #55 failed - step `publish-image` (exit 1)
```
> Pushing to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/owen-experiments:pr-3
> denied: requested access to the resource is denied
> failed to push some refs to 'ghcr.io/redwood-inference/owen-experiments'
```

Owen: pipeline env has GHCR_PAT set to `${GHCR_PAT}` which I added from my profile during onboarding. I gave it repo + workflow scopes when I created it.

Casey: welcome! :wave: short answer: GITHUB_TOKEN from GH Actions is repo-scoped and ephemeral; it doesn't carry over to Buildkite. For pushes from Buildkite you need either an org-installed GitHub App with packages:write or a PAT that includes `write:packages` (and `read:packages`).

Marisol: adding a checklist: 1) confirm PAT has packages scopes; 2) confirm the token is authorized via org SSO if your account is in the org; 3) ensure the Buildkite pipeline secret name matches what the pipeline step expects.

Owen: is there a quick local test to validate the PAT before re-running CI?

Casey: yep. locally run:
```
echo "$CANDIDATE_PAT" | docker login ghcr.io -u <your-github-username> --password-stdin
docker push ghcr.io/redwood-inference/owen-experiments:canary-test
```
if that returns `denied` then packages scope is missing. `gh auth status` and `gh api /user` can show token scopes too.

Owen: ran the docker login test and got `denied`. looks like i forgot packages. will regen token with `write:packages` and update Buildkite.

Marisol: if you prefer not to create a PAT, we can add the org GitHub App to your sandbox repo group. that way Buildkite can use the app installation token. ping me and I can do it or walk you through install.

Owen: regen'd PAT with `read:packages, write:packages`, completed the org SSO approval flow, and updated the GHCR_PAT secret in Buildkite. requeued the build.

Buildkite Bot: build #56 started - step `publish-image`

Buildkite Bot: build #56 succeeded :tada: - image pushed to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/owen-experiments:pr-3

Owen: sweet, green now. adding notes to my onboarding doc about GHCR PAT scopes, SSO, and preferring the org app for long-lived repos. thanks y'all! :smile:
